workstream: WS4 — dataset audit + generation manifest (v1-1 mandatory; v1-3 construct-fidelity screen as clearly-separated optional)
summary: Implements proposal v1-1 with all 9 verdict corrections: a stdlib+yaml audit engine in agent_eval/dataset_audit.py (reference-resolution labeled necessary-not-sufficient, verbatim-only contamination with the sanctioned answers.yaml workspace copy whitelisted, difflib/Jaccard near-duplicates, composition/skew tables with presence-conditional difficulty vocabulary, conditional-judge branch analysis restricted to annotations-only if: conditions via AST scan + score.py:1553 eval semantics with outputs-dependent conditions reported indeterminate) driven by a thin CLI skills/eval-dataset/scripts/audit_dataset.py; generate_synthetic.py persists manifest.yaml (model, temperature, per-seed resolved-prompt sha256, context hash, injectable timestamp, per-seed requested/returned/written counts, per-case provenance from the dict at lines 175-179) and gains --force with REPLACE semantics reconciled with the documented resize flow (seed counts are declarative totals, case_counter restarts at 1, so re-run rewrites case-001..N — refusal without --force, whole case-NNN set replaced with it, synthetic-generation.md updated); workspace.py gains a soft never-failing preflight WARN comparing per-case sha256 content hashes stored in dataset_audit.yaml (not dir mtimes). Config-surface decision: CLI-flags-only recommended over an AuditConfig dataclass — the tunables parameterize a dev-time audit run, nothing on the scoring path consumes them, parameters are recorded inside dataset_audit.yaml for provenance, and the eval.yaml contract stays unchanged (avoiding the silent-drop construction-site wiring the verdict flags and docs churn across 6+ config-enumerating files); if v1-3 ships later, generation.validation becomes the config home. Root-level dataset_audit.yaml/manifest.yaml are invisible to all five dir-only case-discovery sites (workspace.py:66, collect.py:185, harbor/tasks.py:437, evalhub/adapter.py:328/341, sync_dataset.py:87 — verified). The optional v1-3 section (screen_dataset.py LLM construct screen, ValidationConfig on GenerationConfig, v1_estimate labeled "LLM-proxied", human sign-off block, review: required workspace refusal) is planned to the same standard but deferrable to a follow-up PR.
depends_on: Nothing hard: v1-1 is self-contained and touches no other WS surface
Soft: v1-3's screener-vs-generator decorrelation warning reads the generator model from manifest.yaml, so the optional section depends on the mandatory manifest landing first
Soft: the future V3-3 validity report section (other WS) will consume dataset_audit.yaml presence and v1_estimate — no code dependency now

changes.spec: Audit engine shared by the eval-dataset CLI and the workspace.py preflight (pattern: agent_eval/tools/interception.py). Stdlib + yaml only — respects the eval-run scoring-path constraint (ensure_deps.py installs no scipy/pandas). Module constants: ANNOTATION_FIELDS (canonical set MOVED here from generate_synthetic.py:315-322 so audit and generation cannot diverge), CONTAMINATION_EXCLUDED_FIELDS={category,difficulty,severity,constraint_type,topic}, MIN_LEAK_LEN=12, DEFAULT_DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD=0.85, DEFAULT_DIFFICULTY_VALUES=('easy','medium','hard'), AUDIT_FILENAME='dataset_audit.yaml', MANIFEST_FILENAME='manifest.yaml'. @dataclass CaseData(case_id, path, files:list[Path], input_path, input_data:dict|None, input_text:str, annotations:dict, answers:dict|None, parse_errors:list[str]). Functions: iter_case_dirs(dataset_root:Path)->list[Path] (sorted(d for d in iterdir() if d.is_dir()) — exactly mirrors the five discovery sites so root-level files are invisible by construction); load_case(case_dir)->CaseData (input.{yaml,yml,json} preference mirroring workspace._find_input_file at workspace.py:554-560; parse failures recorded in parse_errors, never raised); case_content_hash(case_dir)->str (sha256 over sorted (relpath-bytes, NUL, file-bytes, NUL) of regular files, symlinks skipped — VERDICT CORRECTION 3: content hashes catch in-place edits that POSIX dir mtimes miss); check_structural(cases) (empty/whitespace-only files, unparseable input — SKILL.md Step 6 item 5 subset); check_argument_fields(cases, config) (Step 6 item 3 mechanized, required by the CORRECTION-9 SKILL.md wording: only when execution.mode=='case' and arguments non-empty; simple syntax → regex \{([\w-]+\??)\} matching execute.py:_resolve_arguments:490, '?' marks optional, each required field must be present and non-empty in input.yaml per case; Jinja templates ('{{' present) → best-effort input\.(\w+) extraction with .get(/filters/complex expressions reported status 'indeterminate'); check_reference_resolution(cases, config) (each annotations.expected_files entry resolved relative to config.config_dir per the validate_eval.py:418-426 entry_point convention; per-case findings for missing paths; status 'skipped' with reason when NO case declares expected_files — no warn-spam on non-docs evals; block carries label string 'reference resolution — necessary, not sufficient, for answerability; existence does not verify the file answers the question' — VERDICT CORRECTION 6); check_contamination(cases, config) (answer-key values = leaf strings of annotations minus CONTAMINATION_EXCLUDED_FIELDS plus leaf strings of answers.yaml, normalized lowercase/whitespace-collapsed, only len>=MIN_LEAK_LEN; scanned agent-visible surface = input-file raw text + companion files under dataset.workspace.files roots inside the case dir; answers.yaml itself is NEVER scanned as agent-visible and its presence is NEVER a finding — the workspace copy at workspace.py:248-250 is sanctioned, VERDICT CORRECTION 8; plus misplaced-field findings for input.yaml keys ∩ ANNOTATION_FIELDS extending the generation-only _fix_misplaced_annotation_fields guard to hand-authored cases, and TODO_[A-Z0-9_]+ placeholder findings (informational); block label 'verbatim/normalized-substring only — paraphrased leakage out of scope'); check_near_duplicates(cases, threshold) (O(n²) pairs over normalized input text; difflib.SequenceMatcher with real_quick_ratio/quick_ratio prefilter plus token-set Jaccard; pair flagged when max(seq,jaccard)>=threshold; both scores + metric recorded); check_composition(cases, config, difficulty_values) (by_category table incl '(none)' bucket; when config.generation.strategy=='synthetic' with seeds: per-seed requested=seed.count vs realized=category count plus missing/extra categories; difficulty distribution and vocabulary check PRESENCE-CONDITIONAL — computed only over cases where annotations.difficulty exists, never warns on absence since only agent_eval/prompts/docs/navigation.md:62 declares the easy|medium|hard vocabulary — VERDICT CORRECTION 5); check_conditional_judges(cases, config) (for each JudgeConfig with a condition, populated from the if: key at config.py:1285: _condition_scope() = ast.parse(condition, mode='eval') + collect ast.Name ids → 'annotations-only' when names⊆{'annotations'}, 'outputs-dependent' when 'outputs' referenced, 'invalid' on other names or SyntaxError; annotations-only conditions evaluated per case with eval(condition, {'__builtins__': {}}, {'annotations': annotations}) — score.py:1553-1554 semantics, per-case exceptions tallied; coverage ∈ both|never-runs|always-runs|all-error; outputs-dependent → coverage 'indeterminate', NEVER counted as uncovered — VERDICT CORRECTION 4); run_audit(config, *, duplicate_threshold=0.85, difficulty_values=None, now=None)->dict (orchestrates; result: audit_version=1, generated_at, dataset_path, parameters{duplicate_threshold,difficulty_values}, checks{structural,argument_fields,reference_resolution,contamination,near_duplicates,composition,conditional_judges}, summary{cases,warnings,errors}, cases:{case_id:{sha256,files}} — the preflight staleness input); write_audit(audit, dataset_root)->Path (yaml.safe_dump to root — a FILE, invisible to dir-only discovery); load_audit(dataset_root)->dict|None (missing/corrupt → None). Edge cases: empty dataset → run_audit returns summary with cases=0 and every check skipped; single case → near-duplicates trivially empty; annotations.yaml absent → empty dict, no findings.

Thin CLI wrapper. FIRST import: agent_eval._bootstrap (script uses yaml + agent_eval — house convention; the scripts/agent_eval -> ../../../agent_eval symlink already exists in this dir, verified, so no new symlink needed; tests/test_venv_activation.py auto-enforces both). main(): argparse with --config (required), --duplicate-threshold (float; validated in (0,1] with a clear error — the load-validation the verdict wanted, relocated to the CLI per the flags-only decision), --difficulty-values (comma-separated list of non-empty strings), --strict. Flow: EvalConfig.from_yaml(--config) → resolve dataset root via config.resolve_path(config.dataset.path), error exit 1 if missing → run_audit(...) → write_audit(...) → print human-readable per-check summary (status, finding counts, first N findings) + the audit file path. Exit code 0 always, EXCEPT --strict with any warnings/errors → exit 1 (findings are agent-triaged warnings by default, per the proposal's nudge-not-gate design).

VERDICT CORRECTION 2 reconciliation — REPLACE, not merge: seed counts are declarative totals (SKILL.md Step 0 'resize by editing seed counts') and case_counter always restarts at 1 (line 80), so the documented 'increase count, re-run' flow necessarily rewrites case-001..N; merge/continue-numbering would double categories against their declared totals. (f) _build_manifest(...)/_write_manifest(output_dir, manifest): manifest.yaml at the dataset root with manifest_version:1, generated_at (now arg for deterministic tests, else datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()), model, temperature: GENERATION_TEMPERATURE, context_sha256: sha256 of yaml.dump(config.generation.context, sort_keys=True), seeds: per-seed records, failed_categories, cases: all_cases (per-case {case_id, category, source}). Written only on success, after the empty-dataset RuntimeError check; fully replaced on --force regeneration (the manifest describes the dataset that exists). (g) main(): add --force, pass through, print the manifest path in the report output. generation:
  validation:              # only valid with strategy: synthetic (load-time ValueError otherwise)
    screen_model: claude-sonnet-4-5   # default: any model != manifest.yaml's generator model; warns if equal
